issuer: Bruhat Mahanagara Palike (BBMP), Revenue Department, South Zone, Bengaluru
summary: Your annual property tax of Rs. 9,000 is due for 2025-26. You can get a 5% discount by paying before June 30, 2025, or pay before September 30, 2025 to avoid penalty interest.

actions.task: Pay property tax before rebate deadline to receive 5% discount (Rs. 8,550)

deadline.quote: Pay before 2025-06-30 to avail the 5% early bird discount

actions.why_it_matters: Save Rs. 450 through early payment rebate

actions.task: Final payment of property tax without penalty

deadline.quote: Final date to pay without penalty interest is 2025-09-30

actions.why_it_matters: Avoid 2% per month penalty interest and legal distress warrants

documents_needed: Khata certificate copy (only for first-time manual payments)
if_ignored: Statutory penalty interest of 2% per month on arrears, with risk of distress warrant or property attachment.
